ev_0008.summary: Full circle (center O at (224.2,222), r=157.3) with lettered points A(66.9,222) and B(381.5,222) at the ends of horizontal solid diameter AB, which passes through O. C(210.2,65.3), C'(237.8,379.1) and D(360.7,143.7) lie on the circle. C, O and C' are collinear (CC' passes through O within 0.5 px), so CC' is a diameter. P(270.9,222.7) lies on AB and is joined to C by a solid segment (seg_03). Solid O-C' (seg_04) and dashed D-C' (seg_02) were detected. Only D-C' was confirmed dashed; the supervisor's dashed C-O, O-D and P-C' were not confirmed by CV style analysis (no segments returned). No right-angle mark was verified at O, although AB and CC' are perpendicular by coordinates. point_05 (262.4,200.7) is ignored as a non-vertex; it lies on seg_03 and seg_06 is a fragment of that same stroke, so neither is added.
